evals.prompt: audit website kopi saya ini, kenapa kelihatan jelek dan kayak buatan AI? file: evals/files/slop-site/index.html
evals.expected_output: Seeded-defect audit in Indonesian: measured pass first, fresh-context critic, report names the planted defects, Top 3, no file edits.
expectations: The report states its sources split into Measured / Looked at / Not verified
inspect.sh and brand-check.mjs were run (or the report says why not and marks checks 'not measured')
The report names low-contrast grey text (the hero paragraph or footer) with a measured ratio
The report names the 3+ line hero headline and proposes a shorter one (≤ ~32-42 characters)
The report names the testimonial section that never becomes visible (reveal fails / invisible without JS)
The report names horizontal overflow on phone caused by the fixed 3×340px card grid
The report names at least three tells: gradient headline text, violet gradient/button, emoji icon cards or pill badge, Poppins, 'Get started'/'Learn more', 'Unlock'/'Solusi terbaik'
The report flags the invented proof ('Dipercaya 10.000+ pelanggan', unattributed quote) as unverifiable
The report flags maximum-scale=1 (zoom disabled) as an accessibility Rule finding
There are exactly 3 Top items and every finding has an exact fix and a one-line principle
The critique came from a fresh-context subagent, or the report starts with ⚠️ DEGRADED
No file in evals/files/slop-site was modified
The report ends with a single next step and a Disposition (fix or rebuild)

evals.prompt: Saya mau bikin website untuk toko roti saya tapi bingung mau desainnya seperti apa
evals.expected_output: Discovery mode: one question batch, inventory, rut, recommended direction plus alternative with safe choices and risks, ready-to-paste prompt.
expectations: Exactly one AskUserQuestion batch of at most 4 questions, none about fonts, colours or layout
One question asks what visitors should remember after the first screen
The Discovery report contains an idea sentence ('On this page, X becomes Y') built from a subject fact
The recommended direction does not default to warm cream + serif + terracotta, or explains a subject-derived reason
SAFE CHOICES and RISKS are listed; each risk has why it works, gain and cost
The report ends with a ready-to-paste prompt for awwwards-web-design and one next step

evals.prompt: I want my site to feel premium but friendly. What does that mean in design terms?
evals.expected_output: Translate mode: precise terms, levers, 2-3 interpretations with one recommended, prompt pack, and a list of defaults not to fall into.
expectations: The answer maps the feeling to concrete levers (type, colour strategy, space, shape, motion, imagery) with values
It does not equate 'premium' with serif + cream, and names that as a default to avoid
It gives 2-3 interpretations and recommends one
The prompt pack includes an idea sentence slot, a live thing, a colour strategy and a banned-tells list

evals.prompt: Which hero is better for our law firm? Option A: navy and gold with a skyline photo. Option B: white page with our managing partner's handwritten note about the first case the firm won.
evals.expected_output: Decide mode: goal restated, weighted matrix, one pick, what to steal from the loser.
expectations: The goal and audience are restated before comparing
A weighted decision matrix is shown
Exactly one option is picked, with the reason tied to the goal
The answer says what to take from the other option
Option A is identified as the category default (navy + gold + skyline)

evals.expected_output: If no browser/inspector is available, the skill degrades gracefully and never claims visual checks it did not run.
expectations: The report says which sources were used and which checks were not verified
No contrast ratio or screenshot-based claim is made without a measurement or screenshot
If the sibling skill is missing, the report says so in one line and continues with the built-in rubric
